# Getting Started

First real content chapter. Use this part for foundational material.

## Suggested structure for a chapter

1. Short motivation
2. Core explanation
3. Worked example
4. Exercises or checklist

## Worked example

```text
# Good chapter file names (lexicographic order = sidebar order)
01-getting-started.qmd
02-core-concepts.qmd
03-practice.qmd

# Optional intermediate insert without renumbering everything
02a-quick-reference.qmd
```

## Checklist

- [ ] Folder name uses a numeric prefix (`01-foundations`)
- [ ] Chapter file has a `title:` in frontmatter
- [ ] Ran `bash scripts/update-index.sh` after structural edits
- [ ] Previewed with `quarto preview` or `./indipub.sh <BookName>` from `books/`

## Images

Put assets under `images/` at the book root and reference them relatively:

```markdown
![Diagram](../../images/example.png)
```

(Adjust the relative path based on chapter depth.)
